title: Benchmark requirements and durable layout
goal: Define benchmark purpose, persistent eval directory layout, schemas, scoring policy, and success thresholds.

title: Source taxonomy and coverage map
goal: Map selected manual/source families to benchmark domains, user levels, and target question counts.

title: Question schema and manifest tooling
goal: Create the machine-readable question schema, manifest format, validation rules, and seed examples.

title: Property benchmark questions
goal: Generate hard source-backed property questions covering defaults, ranges, dynamic changes, check SQL, and cautions.

title: SQL DDL DML and compatibility questions
goal: Generate hard source-backed SQL, DDL, DML, data type, JSON, LOB, function, and Oracle-difference questions.

title: Operations backup recovery questions
goal: Generate hard source-backed installation, startup, shutdown, backup, restore, recovery, tablespace, and admin runbook questions.

title: Views performance and monitoring questions
goal: Generate hard source-backed dictionary, performance view, optimizer, plan, monitoring, SNMP, and tuning questions.

title: Replication CDC security network questions
goal: Generate hard source-backed replication, CDC, Log Analyzer, RepMgr, security, TLS, and network diagnostic questions.

title: Error and troubleshooting questions
goal: Generate hard source-backed error-code, symptom, cause/action, log collection, and troubleshooting questions.

title: Tools APIs connectors migration questions
goal: Generate hard source-backed PSM, external procedure, JDBC, CLI, ODBC, Precompiler, iSQL, iLoader, utilities, connectors, Kubernetes, migration, Spatial, NiFi, and Tableau questions.

title: Attachments-only answer generation runner
goal: Implement the durable script that projects question records to the allowed answering input, runs answer generation using only GPTs/attachments as retrieval context, checks for judge-only metadata leakage, and records model responses.

title: Source-backed judge and readiness reports
goal: Implement source-backed judge/report tooling that compares attachments-only answers against expected facts, required tokens, prohibited claims, and readiness thresholds, with calibration samples and validation commands.
